terra.problem: The text does not say the woman stays at Jesus' feet for the whole scene.
The hat joke does not make sense: Papa wearing a hat does not explain why he would put perfume on Jesus' head.
The text does not say the woman remains by Jesus' feet for the whole scene.
The text does not say that the jar never changes hands.
The text says the Pharisee speaks to himself, but it does not say that nobody at the table hears him.
Jesus says Simon did not greet Him with a kiss; the text does not place that greeting at the door.
Saying Simon skipped the greeting goes beyond the text. Jesus says Simon did not greet Him with a kiss, not that he gave no greeting at all.
The passage does not say that anointing the head with oil was a welcome.
The text does not say the woman had been at Jesus' feet the whole time.
Saying Papa's mustache is the only fancy facial hair in the story puts him into the Bible event. It also makes a claim about the others' appearance that the text does not support.
The text says the Twelve were with Jesus; it does not say nobody was left at the last village.
The text does not say whether anyone passed a hat.
Saying Minty carries messages presents her past habit as something she does now. Papa does not know what his cookie cutter kids are doing now.
Jesus' preaching is described in Luke 8:1, not in the verse about the women's ministry, Luke 8:3.
